title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Underwriting Schedule — Credit Line Increase Figures
content:
The credit line increase figures of each Ridgeline Pro Credit tier are shown below.

| Tier | Months open before an increase (full months) | Months after the last line change (full months) | Maximum increase (percent of the current line) | Financials threshold (USD) | Rounding increment (USD) | Clean-history months |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 6 | 6 | 25 | 15000.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 6 | 6 | 25 | 25000.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 6 | 6 | 25 | 25000.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 12 | 6 | 25 | 100000.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 12 | 12 | 20 | 250000.00 | 500.00 | 12 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 12 | 12 | 15 | 1000000.00 | 500.00 | 12 |

## Column meanings

- **Months open before an increase**: full months the account must have been open before a credit line increase.
- **Months after the last line change**: full months after the last credit line change before another increase.
- **Maximum increase**: the largest increase in one credit line increase, as a percentage of the current line.
- **Financials threshold**: a requested new line above this figure requires business financial statements and is referred to Commercial Credit underwriting.
- **Rounding increment**: the increment to which a new credit line is rounded down.
- **Clean-history months**: the months before the request taken as the account's late-charge history.

Hypothetical illustration: on a Commercial Account Net 45, a requested new line of 250000.00 is at the financials threshold and not above it; a request of 250000.01 is above it.
